name: app-clients-testimonials-oversized-black-headline-slide
title: Clients Testimonials Oversized Headline
whatItIs: A white slide with a huge black two-line 'Clients Testimonials' at top left and, at the lower right, a paragraph quote with a small avatar, name and title at the left.
whatItMeans: Very large heavy type against a small quote gives a strong hierarchy and an editorial feel.
techniques: Giant heavy headline as the main graphic
Small quote paragraph placed low right
Tiny avatar with name at the opposite side

vocabulary.definition: Placing very large and very small text together.
Elements at opposite corners balancing the layout.
A slide presenting a client's words.
